Synopsis:
    US equity funds posted a second consecutive week of outflows (~$11.1B), driven by rising bond yields and oil prices stemming from US-Iran military escalation near the Strait of Hormuz. Outflows moderated vs. the prior week, partly cushioned by strong AI-sector earnings (Nvidia, Dell). Flight-to-safety dynamics are visible: money market funds surged to a 4-week high intake ($48.8B), short-duration Treasuries attracted $4.53B, while bond fund inflows hit a 5-week low. Tech, financials, and industrials led sectoral outflows.
